previous_statement: Using the registered formulas sgn(X)=X(X^2)^(-1/2) and theta(X)=(I+sgn(X))/2, node 1.1.2.1 yields sgn(T-I)=(-U)U^(-1)=-I and theta(T-I)=0.
new_statement: Put U=I-T and X=T-I=-U. The children establish (X^2)^(-1/2)=U^(-1) directly from ||T||<1/3. Hence the registered formulas sgn(X)=X(X^2)^(-1/2) and theta(X)=(I+sgn(X))/2 give sgn(T-I)=(-U)U^(-1)=-I and theta(T-I)=0.
